alt: An empty blue folding bistro chair on a flagstone plaza, a dog-walker passing behind it and a historical map display to the right.
description: An empty powder-blue metal folding chair sits alone on a plaza paved with irregular flagstones and red brick. Behind it, a person in a blue dress walks a small cream-coloured dog on a leash. To the right, a plywood board mounted outdoors displays a historical town map and black-and-white archival photographs. Bright midday sun throws hard shadows across the stone.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: Seen through a clinic window: a man in a Blue Moose sweatshirt from behind, overlaid with the words ACUPUNCTURE and SHOCKWAVE.
description: A view through the glass front of a clinic. White and yellow vinyl lettering on the window reads 'ACUPUNCTURE', 'SHOCKWAVE' and 'ICBC PROVIDER'. Behind and reflected in the glass, a man with closely cropped hair is seen from behind in a dark patterned sweatshirt printed with a 'Blue Moose — Hope, British Columbia, Canada' logo. A white moulded chair stands in the foreground while reflections of the street layer over the interior.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A pale blue ceramic dog bowl full of water on a sunlit sidewalk beside a Parkside Brewery sandwich-board sign.
description: A pale blue ceramic dog bowl, decorated with a black bone and a chevron band and filled with water, rests on a sunlit concrete sidewalk. Beside it stands a black A-frame sandwich board for The Parkside Brewery, illustrated with a yellow iced drink, a lemon slice and a red straw, above the words 'PURCHASE … FOR … BEER'. Strong angular shadows cross the pavement.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: Shot from the sidewalk through a shop window: a hanging OPEN sign, and inside a mannequin of a man in a red mesh tank top gazing out.
description: Photographed from the sidewalk through a shop window. A black-and-white 'OPEN' sign hangs from a beaded chain on a suction cup against the dark glass. Behind it, inside the shop, stands a mannequin of a man in a red mesh tank top, dramatically lit so he seems to gaze out through the glass toward the street.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A white soft-toy figure in a pink polka-dot dress standing on a windowsill above a hedge of oak-leaf foliage.
description: Seen from outside through a window, a rounded white soft-toy figure in a pink polka-dot dress stands on an interior sill among other small objects. Green oak-leaf foliage fills the lower foreground, and the building's orange and yellow walls frame the glass.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: Looking up at a billboard of a smiling woman in white sunglasses, with a floodlight arm against a cloud-streaked blue sky.
description: Photographed from below, the corner of a billboard cuts diagonally across a blue sky streaked with thin cloud. A black floodlight reaches out on an arm to light the board, which shows a woman with wind-blown dark hair and white sunglasses, smiling, her image skewed by the steep upward angle.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A sun-worn advertising poster behind glass showing a blonde woman with closed eyes, partly stripped and patched.
description: A weathered advertising poster behind glass, washed by sunlight and crossed by reflections. It pictures a blonde woman in a white top, eyes closed and smiling, with hands resting on her shoulders. The print has abraded and peeled, and a crumpled scrap of paper sits over the centre of her face. A blue perforated panel runs down the right edge.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: Two life-size cutout faces of two women peering up from behind a dense green hedge in front of office windows.
description: Two life-size cardboard cutouts of women's faces rise just above a dense green hedge, positioned in front of a building's large windows so they seem to peer over the foliage. The glass behind them reflects trees and a neighbouring building.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: Large and small versions of the same smiling face pasted on a masonry wall, with the halftone portrait crossed by purple spray paint and hard shadows.
description: Large and small versions of the same smiling face appear on a textured white masonry wall. The large portrait is rendered in black halftone dots across overlapping sheets of pasted paper and crossed on the right by purple spray paint. A smaller version sits at the upper left among cropped black lettering, while hard sunlight throws diagonal shadows over the paper and wall.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A white plastic road barricade leaning to one side, its orange-and-white striped rail in bright sunlight outside a shop window.
description: A white plastic road barricade leans to one side at the edge of a sidewalk, its long rail marked with alternating orange and white diagonal stripes. Behind it, ornamental grass grows in a rust-coloured planter beneath a dark shop window displaying small bags. Strong sunlight casts crisp tree shadows and the silhouette of a person across the concrete wall, paving and barricade.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A makeshift sign taped into a wall recess reads FRESH BEER THIS WAY in red capitals above a right-pointing arrow.
description: A temporary white sign fills a shallow recess in a pale grey stucco wall. Large red capital letters read 'FRESH BEER THIS WAY' above a broad arrow pointing right. The sign is held in place by wrinkled beige paper and many strips of masking tape, with leaf shadows falling across it and a beer keg partly visible at the far right.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: The back of a yellow sunflower leaning against the red bars of a metal fence in bright sunlight.
description: Seen from behind, a yellow sunflower leans toward the red bars and broad central post of a metal fence. Its green, bristled flower head and stem face the camera while the petals spread unevenly around them. Fine spiderwebs catch between the bars, and a sunlit garden falls out of focus beyond the fence.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: A faded pink-and-blue printed portrait of a smiling moustached astronaut, closely framed behind a reflective surface.
description: A close view of a faded printed portrait showing a smiling astronaut with short dark hair and a moustache. His face is tinted pale pink and blue, with the circular collar of his spacesuit visible around his shoulders. Scuffs, creases and a small torn patch mark the image, while faint reflections and glare wash across its surface.
creator: John Braybrooke

alt: The word NEEDS in white capital letters on a grey storefront panel crossed by sharp diagonal shadows.
description: White capital letters spelling 'NEEDS' sit alone on a broad grey storefront panel. Strong sunlight throws a pattern of long diagonal shadows across the word and wall. Metal framing, a white drainpipe and cropped pale pink-and-white panels edge the otherwise spare composition.
creator: John Braybrooke
